nab_norman.armyName: Norman and Breton (Norman) - 911 AD to 1189 AD)

units.name: King or Duke
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Noble
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Norman Knights
units.description: A Norman Knight has light armour, spear and shield. Shock Cavalry. Superior Fighters. May have heavy armour (+1) and lance (+1).

units.name: Norman Retainers
units.description: A Norman Retainer has javelins and shield. May exchange javelins for spear (free). May be fielded as skirmishers.

units.name: Breton Knights
units.description: A Breton Knight has light armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Evade. May have heavy armour (+1) and javelins (+1). Models in light amour carrying javelins may be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 25 points per base.

units.name: Breton Retainers
units.description: A Breton Retainer has javelins and shield. Evade. May exchange javelins for spear (free). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 17 points per base.

units.name: Dismounted Knights
units.description: Dismounted Knights have spear, light armour and shield. Superior Fighters. May exchange spear for throwing spear (+2) or two-handed weapon (+2). May have heavy armour (+2) and javelins(+2).

units.name: Norman Spearmen
units.description: Norman Spearmen have spear and shield.

units.name: French or Flemish Spearmen
units.description: French or Flemish Spearmen have spear and shield.

units.name: Norman Archers
units.description: Norman Archers have a bow. Open Order. May exchange bow for crossbow (+2). May be fiedled as skirmishers at a cost of six points per base (archers) or sven points per base (crossbowmen). There may not be more armed with crossbow than bows.

units.name: French or Flemish Archers
units.description: French or Flemish Archers have a bow. Open Order. May exchange bow for crossbow (+2). May be fiedled as skirmishers at a cost of six points per base (archers) or sven points per base (crossbowmen). There may not be more armed with crossbow than bows.

units.name: Breton Retainers (Infantry)
units.description: Breton Retainers have throwing spear and shield. Open Order.

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Skirmishers. May exchange javelins and shield for sling or bow (-1).
